title: machine edf dbf
summary: One preemptive machine must run three independent recurring jobs. Their (execution time C, period T, relative deadline D) triples are (1,5,3), (2,6,2), and (4,15,8). Releases recur forever with each job's first release at time 0. A capacity dashboard reports total utilization 0.8. The team must determine whether earliest-deadline-first can meet every deadline on this single machine, including any short-interval overload.
